newsitem.title: USA: Fieldcrest Cannon sees Q3 loss.
newsitem.headline: Fieldcrest Cannon sees Q3 loss.

text.p: Fieldcrest Cannon Inc said Wednesday it will report a loss for the third quarter, ending September 30, due to lower-than-expected operating results and higher than expected expenses associated with the closing of two towel facilities.

Before non-recurring charges, third-quarter results could approximate break-even or a loss up to $0.25 a share compared with net income of $4.7 million, or $0.40 a share, in the third quarter of 1995.

"In addition, expenses in connection with closing two towel facilities and the related towel plant consolidation will be about $1 million higher than originally anticipated," said chief executive James M. Fitzgibbons.
That will double the previously projected costs of $1 million, spokesman R.E. Reece said.

"We are disappointed that third-quarter operating results will be below expectations," Fitzgibbons said. "This is due to a combination of lower-than-projected sales and margins at our Blanket Division and Sure Fit and lower margins at our Bed Division."

Although Sure Fit operations have been disappointing, the company said, it is taking steps to improve Sure Fit's future operating results. These include reducing working capital, cost reductions which will provide for profitability at the current reduced sales levels, and transferring certain fabrication operations to Sure Fit's facility which were previously performed by outside processors.

As announced earlier, the company has retained a financial advisor in connection with the possible sale of its Blanket Division, which had net sales of $71 million in 1995 and net assets of approximately $40 million. Proceeds from any sale would be used to reduce debt and for reinvestment in the company's core businesses.

"We continue the long-term process of strategically repositioning Fieldcrest Cannon around our core businesses," Fitzgibbons said. "Our objective is to strengthen our company financially by lowering debt and improving operating results at our core businesses. This means aggressively removing costs and shedding those operations that do not contribute to the long-term financial viability of Fieldcrest Cannon."
